author: goryanya-deploy[bot]
body:
## Owner confirmation: one existing host, unified installer

Current direct Telegram reply: «Размещаем на существующем сервере. Наша задача что бы все было на одном сервере. Я напоминаю, что мы планируем сделать one touch установку сервера.»

This answers the explicit placement question for157.180.49.125: dedicated isolated TURN service, TCP/UDP34781 and UDP40000–40015, restricted networking, reviewed update of ParanoID with rollback; DNS, existing TLS pin, identities/history/database and neighboring services preserved. Authority is conditional on successful tests and independent review, NOT a waiver of TURN runtime/ACL/lifecycle or CALL-CONNECT01 acceptance. No permanent ADR approval/permalink is invented.

Product requirement: messaging, database and voice relay operate on ONE host and are installed/updated/checked/rolled back by ONE reproducible ParanoID installer. Separate users/systemd services are internal isolation, not extra required servers or manual per-component onboarding. Fresh installation and safe existing-v8 upgrade must be distinguished; re-run must not overwrite identities, credentials or data. No one-touch readiness is claimed yet.

Implementation is being resumed around the unified package and missing acceptance. Previous platform-rejected actions are not approved for bypass; concrete test execution remains subject to tool safety and real evidence. Live exposure only after the recorded gates pass.
scope: Bot-recorded direct Telegram quote, confirmed by current user task; not permanent human ADR acceptance.
